title: Infant and Child European Cryoablation Project ICECaP
official: Infant and Child European Cryoablation Project ICECaP
summary: A registry to audit the current range of applications, technical success rate, safety profile, complication rate and efficacy of cryoablation procedures being performed in children.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* all children in whom a clinical decision is made to treat with percutaneous cryoablation, to include those in whom cryoablation was not technically or clinically possible at any stage.

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
sponsor: Great Ormond Street Hospital for Children NHS Foundation Trust
